aboutStoryBody: Punyakart Foundation is a dedicated animal welfare organization and non-profit sanctuary located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. Founded with the sacred motto of “People | Animals | A Better Tomorrow”, we provide a safe, permanent haven, 24x7 emergency medical treatment, and nutritious daily feeding for over 1,187+ abandoned, disabled, and injured animals.

crowdFaq2Q: Will I get an 80G tax receipt?
crowdFaq2A: Yes, all donations are eligible for up to 50% tax benefit under Section 80G. You will receive an instant 80G receipt on your email immediately after payment.
crowdFaq3Q: Can I donate from outside India?
crowdFaq3A: Yes, we accept international donations through credit/debit cards and trusted payment gateways in major currencies.
crowdFaq4A: Absolutely. All transactions are encrypted with bank-grade security through trusted payment gateways like Razorpay.
